preflight.note: Runtime evidence is human-attested, not automatically proven. Existing exact-source manifests, allowlists, build, CI and LQA remain required.

evidence.note: Read the four exact FU NPC definitions and their dialog branches; each has baseType=hostilefu. The Apex instances are species=apex, hellguard is species=floran, and pyramidguard appears as species=avian in inspected placements.

Read both exact patch bodies. templeguard and tombguard patches replace /scriptConfig/dialog/attack; their full vanilla .npctype definitions are absent from this FU checkout, so no parent or behavior was inferred.

Read entityVariant/loadDialog/queryDialog/speciesDialog/sayToEntity. The helper resolves NPC species first and target species second with defaults; it establishes selection logic, not active event callers or live triggers.

FU hostilefu parent sets baseType=base, behavior=hostileguard, and generic hail/attack dialog routes. The vanilla base and active hostileguard behavior caller implementation are not available here. labguard types also point attack at /dialog/miniknogthreats.config:attack, whose target file is absent.

Inspected every dungeon/map file containing the six type identifiers, including map typeName/species NPC brushes and Tiled npcTypes spawners. These are static placement references; they do not establish when hail/attack dialogue is actively invoked.
Grounded named as a distinct group opposed to the council.
Grounded discussed as Avians who defy their god; same source later says atheist Avians.
Grounded contrasted with Flightless devoted to Kluex. These available lore texts establish a named community,not generic surface location.
